preprocessing: Deterministic full RGB resize512, antialiasFalse, fixed RF mean/std; no crop/mosaic.

images.review_note: One real bird. Tighten the old publisher margin while including the visible beak, feathers and feet; preserve original coordinates in provenance.
One raccoon, no cat. Reject RF Cat proposal; retain reviewed Raccoon target. This is a visible-scene absence check, not an absence inferred from labels.
One real cat, matching publisher and RF geometry. Computer-mouse guess on the foreground calculator is not retained. Books and other objects remain unknown.
One kitchen knife and two visible leeks. Retain leaf Kitchen knife and Vegetable targets; omit duplicate generic Knife ancestor. Hand-only RF Person is not retained.
One bottle. Glass/beer/cup specificity is not adopted from model guesses.
Retain only the real cropped metal spoon at upper left. The two chocolate spoon-shaped decorations are not metal cutlery targets; dessert/table/glass guesses are outside this target subset.
Coffee cup and saucer extents checked on original. Omit liquid Coffee and generic RF Cup/Knife guesses; retain the publisher leaf targets once each.
Three real airplanes with checked individual boxes, including two small distant planes.

Retain the foreground human face and person extent. Man/Woman publisher raw provenance is retained, but RF uses the fixed generic Person canonical identity; no gender inference is added. Small crowd instances remain unknown.
Two clear motorcycles retained. Tiny/cropped additional bike, tires, wheels, clothing and RF chair/bus guesses remain outside this partial target subset.
One bus and foreground car retained. Distant car, small lamps, traffic-light guess and cyclist are outside this partial target subset.
Umbrella canopy and pole retained as a positive target. People, dog, chairs and cups remain unknown; RF microwave is a false guess on storage drawers.
Clear overhead traffic signal retained. Small distant signals remain unknown; do not assert class completeness.
Real cropped camera assembly. Publisher geometry agrees with unchanged broad control. RF absence is expected from its pretrained label coverage and is not a negative.
One real mobile phone; headset remains unknown. Phone box includes its cropped right/bottom extent.
One real television checked against RF and publisher geometry. RF remote and broad office-building/table guesses not retained.
One visible bed and three actual head pillows retained. Folded towel sculpture on the duvet is not a fourth pillow, despite the broad-model guess.
Two visible door leaves retained. Shadowed person/clothing remain unknown; no class absence inferred.

Oval mirror component, including its frame, retained with a revised box. Washstand support, basin, jug, furniture and reflections remain outside this target subset. RF sink/chair guesses are not adopted.
